content: Laravel 11 official Eloquent guidance documents created model events, observer classes with event-named methods, and registering observers through the model lifecycle. It also documents that mass updates or deletes do not retrieve models and therefore do not dispatch model events; an observer can implement ShouldHandleEventsAfterCommit when it must wait for an outer transaction to commit. Use the created observer for normal model saves, while explicitly recognizing query-builder bulk inserts and muted events as outside observer coverage.
